services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Please select the Friday you wish to visit to check availability, choose a time slot, and purchase your tickets. There are no guided tours. For a self-guided experience, please download our museum app ahead of time and bring your earbuds! The Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum is an educational institution that uses trans-disciplinary approaches to increasing knowledge about the past, present, and future, especially related to the diversity and relationships in nature and among cultures.
